name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animate/combat, descriptor=speech_bubbles. No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the behavior (a 10-frame fade-in of the pre-attack combat 'vs' speech bubbles).
purpose: Pre-attack 'vs' speech-bubble fade-in for an AI fast-path physical attack: compute bubble screen positions (attacker bubble for the defender, plus the counter bubble for the attacker if the defender can counter), play a 10-frame fade-in, and return the pos-pairs table address for combatant HP-bar placement.
logic_summary: Step 1: fd2_compute_combat_bubble_screen_pos(&pos_pairs[0], defender_idx) writes the primary bubble (x,y) into pos_pairs[0..1]. Step 2: fd2_check_can_counter_attack(attacker_idx, defender_idx); if it returns 1, compute the counter bubble into pos_pairs[2..3] from attacker_idx, else store -1 in pos_pairs[2] as the no-counter sentinel. Then a 10-iteration loop (frame_iter 0..9, sprite_id = frame_iter + 0x27 = 0x27..0x30): each frame alloc+blit the attacker bubble at (pos_pairs[0],pos_pairs[1]) onto surface 0xA0000 (pitch 0x140) via fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk, and the counter bubble at (pos_pairs[2],pos_pairs[3]) when pos_pairs[2] != -1; fd2_delay_ms(0x19) (~25ms); for frames 0..8 undo the blit(s) via fd2_cleanup_dialog_sprite_buffer before the next frame. After the loop (frame 9 left on screen) free(attacker_buf) and free(counter_buf) when present, then return &pos_pairs[0].

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the attacking/casting char (caller passes param_1, the AI caster). Forwarded to fd2_check_can_counter_attack and used as the source index for the counter-attacker's bubble position (pos_pairs[2..3]).
params.reason: Name matches its use as the attacker index; no address residue.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the targeted char (caller passes ai_best_physical_target_idx). Used as the source index for the primary bubble position (pos_pairs[0..1]) and forwarded to fd2_check_can_counter_attack.
params.reason: Name matches its use as the defender/target index; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Address of data_fd2_battle_combat_speech_bubble_pos_pairs. The sole caller reads [0..1] (defender bubble x,y) via this pointer and [2..3] (counter bubble x,y) via pointer+8 to place the combatants' HP bars; [2]==-1 signals no counter.
